base.radius: radius.lg (8px), or 8px 0 0 0 when bleeding off a media tile

glassBorder.$comment: Frosted-frame pseudo-element pattern wrapping mock UI cards. Real CSS custom-property-driven, not a flat border.
glassBorder.afterRule: 1px solid #fff, mask-image linear-gradient(90deg, #fff, transparent) at inset -8px

gradientBorder.$comment: Used on 4:3 media tiles (why-taito, integrations). Two masked pseudo-elements creating a 1px ring with a diagonal light/dark gradient sheen.
